scenes.label: 01 / QUICK MT5 CONNECTION GUIDE
title: ONE-CLICK.
QUICK MT5 SYNC.
scenes.voice: Connecting MetaTrader five is fast and seamless. Simply run the one-click sync command to automatically link your live terminal and stream trade history with zero manual configuration.

title: DISCOVER &
CHOOSE ACCOUNTS.
scenes.voice: Scan your computer to detect all active MT5 accounts. Choose which trading accounts you want in your journal, and safely remove deleted accounts with permanent protection.

title: LESS NOISE.
MORE CLARITY.
scenes.voice: The Command Center provides instant clarity on your net profit, win rate, profit factor, and equity curve, updated in real time across all your trading accounts.

scenes.label: 04 / TRADE LOGGING & CALENDAR
title: CAPTURE
EVERY DETAIL.
scenes.voice: Log every position with precision. Capture your entries, exits, fees, and strategy tags, and track your daily consistency on the trading calendar.

scenes.label: 05 / DAILY JOURNAL & PSYCHOLOGY
title: REPLAY. REFLECT.
BUILD DISCIPLINE.
scenes.voice: Master trader psychology with the daily journal. Attach chart screenshots, record your execution rating, and track mistakes to build unbreakable discipline.

scenes.label: 06 / PERFORMANCE & EDGE
title: DISCOVER
YOUR EDGE.
scenes.voice: Deep dive into performance analytics. Compare strategies, symbols, and session times to uncover your true statistical edge and eliminate losing habits.
